claims.body: The textbook inverse relationship between gold and 10y real yields held at roughly -0.73 rolling correlation from 2003 to 2022, where a 100bp rise in real yields implied about an 18% fall in the real gold price. Since 2024 it has decoupled: gold has risen alongside positive and rising real yields.
claims.why_it_matters: Any setup justified by 'real yields are falling so gold goes up' is running a model that stopped working. Check the current correlation against its long-run value before leaning on it.

claims.body: Central banks displaced ETFs as the marginal buyer of gold from 2024. Q2 2026 official-sector purchases were a record 288.9t, up 62% year-on-year, and occurred during gold's steepest quarterly decline since 2013. A WGC survey of 76 central banks found 45% intend to increase reserves over the next 12 months.
claims.why_it_matters: This is the structural floor under the bull case. It is price-insensitive and slow, which is why dips have been bought. If the buying pace falls sharply, the whole thesis weakens and gold becomes a momentum trade.

claims.body: Producer/merchant COT positioning is the closest gold analogue to corporate insider selling: miners selling forward production they own and whose cost base they know. But much producer hedging is mandated by project-finance covenants rather than a price view.
claims.why_it_matters: Separate mechanical from discretionary before scoring it, exactly as you would separate a CFO's open-market purchase from tax withholding on a Form 4. Only the discretionary part is signal.
sources: Cohen/Malloy/Pomorski on routine vs opportunistic insiders

claims.body: Gold is OTC. There is no consolidated tape and no NBBO. A broker's XAUUSD is a dealer quote; on IC Markets it is a CFD at 100oz per lot with their spread on top. The only executable benchmarks are the two daily LBMA auctions at 10:30 and 15:00 London, administered by ICE Benchmark Administration.
claims.why_it_matters: Your fill is your broker's price, not 'the' gold price. Basis to COMEX and the LBMA fix is worth watching before sizing up.

claims.body: GOFO was discontinued on 30 January 2015. Gold lease rates are no longer published and must be derived as USD funding (SOFR) less the forward-implied rate.
claims.why_it_matters: Any source offering a live GOFO feed is offering a reconstruction. Fine — but it should say so, and you should know the inputs.

claims.body: COT describes the Tuesday of its report week and is released the following Friday at 15:30 ET. It is three days stale on release and up to ten by the following week.
claims.why_it_matters: It is a regime tool, never a timing tool. Positioning extremes tell you the crowd is stretched, not that the turn is today.
